partnershipPlan: A patient partner and a caregiver from the advisory council review the plain-language summary; an oncology nurse navigator reviews how calls are described.
socialListening: No social media listening; the centre's patient experience comments are not used because they are local data.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: When my hands started peeling I did not know if it was serious; having the pharmacist's number meant I did not wait three weeks.
items.implication: Report time to toxicity recognition where available.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My father lives alone two hours away; nobody is there to notice when he is not eating.
items.implication: State that people living alone and far away are thinly studied.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If we cut the dose at the first sign of trouble, we may be protecting them from the drug and from the benefit.
items.implication: Keep dose intensity as a balancing outcome.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Last time the committee funded a service on one savings figure that never appeared.
items.implication: Report costs as ranges and never net them against effects.

summary: Four composite voices on access, living alone, dose intensity and misleading figures.
